text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day in the early afternoon, I spot
Grass
Wonder deep in contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I really shouldn't eat too much
more, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I'm trying to decide the
appropriate
amount of food for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing to admit this,
but... I'm
afraid I may have already gone
and stuffed
myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was so lovely out, my classmates
and I had
tea together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I was having such a wonderful time
chatting
and drinking, I kept reaching
for sweet after
sweet.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You should have seen it. Spe had a treat
in each
hand the whole time... Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The question is, what am I to do now? I
suppose
you might consider this my just
deserts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder looks to me for an answer.
It'd be
bad for her health if she ate too
much, but sweets
are no substitute for a
proper lunch...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You might be right there. For
today, I
should practice restraint.
choice_data_list: 『大食は命の取り越し』とも言うよ
『腹が減っては戦ができぬ』とも言うよ

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Still, our tea party was such a
treat. Won't
you join us next time,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I promise you I'll be moderate with my
sweets
intake. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Making tea with her friends seems to
have put
Grass Wonder in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... I agree, a lackluster meal leads to
a
lackluster performance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Having a balanced diet is part of one's
training
regimen. I might be overeating a
little, but my
body needs its nutrients. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. With that settled, I'll have to pick

something that compliments the leftover
tea...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder makes a conscious effort
to eat
well and better her training.
